title: License-clean drone frame to orthophoto geolocalization (ALIKED / DISK / SIFT + LightGlue)
summary: Drone frame => NAIP orthophoto => lat/lon using only permissively licensed parts: ALIKED (BSD-3), DISK and LightGlue weights (Apache-2.0), OpenCV SIFT and MAGSAC (Apache-2.0), rasterio, public-domain NAIP from Microsoft Planetary Computer and CC0 eBee frames from OpenDroneMap. Generates synthetic frames with known truth (rotation, scale, perspective, photometric change, cross-season source) and runs real UAV frames with EXIF GPS as truth. Measured error and CPU runtime per frame are in the README.
verified: Ran 2026-11-06 on Apple M2 Max CPU (torch 2.15.0, Python 3.12.14): download_data.py fetched NAIP 2023/2019 windows from Planetary Computer and 5 CC0 eBee frames; run_eval.py on 20 synthetic frames per case: same-map median error 0.10-0.11 m for ALIKED/DISK/SIFT+LightGlue (0.28-2.8 s/frame), cross-season 1.9-4.8 m with 13-20/20 fixes; real eBee frames vs NAIP: 1 fix out of 5 (ALIKED, 2019 map, tight prior, 11.0 m error), 0/5 in all other configs. Numbers and logs in README.
